# Dinkum Tracker

> A free, browser-based progress tracker for the game Dinkum.
> Data is stored in your browser. No account or login is required. Cloud sync is optional.

## What it tracks

- **Pedia**: fish, bugs and critters, with donation status for the museum
- **Milestones, Licenses, Skills and Buildings**: progress levels that follow the game's rules
- **NPCs and Calendar**: relationship hearts, birthdays and events by season and day
- **Recipes**: cooking, crafting and sign writing
- **Gear**: books, cassettes, tools, weapons, equipment and vehicles
- **Wardrobe and home**: clothing, furniture and decorations
- **Playthroughs**: several save files, kept apart

## Pages

- `/overview`: progress across every area
- `/pedia`, `/npcs`, `/calendar`
- `/buildings`, `/licenses`, `/milestones`, `/skills`
- `/recipes`, `/gear`, `/wardrobe`
- `/items-breakdown`: the raw resources a list of items needs
- `/weight-calculator`: the price of weighted items
- `/reference`: animals, resources, plants, the Food Modeller and daily milestones
- `/settings`: language, number and date formats, theme, backup and optional cloud sync

## Technical notes

- Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
- Available in 19 languages
- No backend and no analytics code in the app. Playthrough data lives in browser localStorage
- Cloud sync, when turned on, keeps one file in your own Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or GitHub
- Open source, no ads
